mapper.select: /*common.mpif.selectRfcYPProperties*/ SELECT F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',3) AS JCO_CLIENT, F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',2) AS JCO_LANG, F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',1) AS JCO_SYSNR, TEXT2 AS JCO_USER, TEXT3 AS JCO_PASSWD, TEXT4 AS JCO_ASHOST FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'YPST' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND VALUE1 = TO_NUMBER(#{st_server_mode}) AND FLAG = 'Y'
